title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Mark 12: the parable of the vineyard, the question about taxes, the greatest commandment and the poor widow.

questions.text: In the parable, what did the man do with the vineyard he had planted before he went into another country?
questions.explanation: The man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, and rented it out to a farmer before going into another country.

answers.text: He rented it out to a farmer
He sold it to the chief priests
He left it standing empty
He gave it to his son

questions.text: How did the farmers treat the servants the owner sent to get his share of the fruit?
questions.explanation: They beat the first servant and sent him away empty, threw stones at another and wounded him in the head, and killed others.

answers.text: They paid them more than was asked
They sent them back with gifts
They beat them and killed some of them
They refused to open the gate

questions.text: Whom did the owner of the vineyard send to the farmers last of all?
questions.explanation: Still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying that they would respect his son.

answers.text: Another servant
His beloved son
A band of soldiers
A neighboring farmer

questions.text: What did Jesus say the lord of the vineyard would do?
questions.explanation: He said the lord of the vineyard will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

answers.text: Forgive the farmers and wait another year for the fruit
Sell the vineyard and settle in another country
Raise the rent that the farmers must pay
Destroy the farmers and give the vineyard to others

questions.text: Whose image and inscription were on the denarius that was brought to Jesus?
questions.explanation: When he asked whose image and inscription it was, they said to him that it was Caesar's.

answers.text: David's
Herod's
Caesar's
Moses'

questions.text: Which group that came to Jesus is described as saying that there is no resurrection?
questions.explanation: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him and asked him a question.

answers.text: The Sadducees
The Herodians
The scribes
The elders

questions.text: What did Jesus say about those who rise from the dead?
questions.explanation: He said that when they rise from the dead they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

answers.text: They keep the wives they had on the earth
They are each given a new name in heaven
They no longer remember their life on earth
They do not marry, but are like angels in heaven

questions.text: What did Jesus name as the greatest commandment of all?
questions.explanation: He answered that the greatest is to hear that the Lord our God is one, and to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind and strength.

answers.text: To bring whole burnt offerings to the temple
To love the Lord your God with all your heart
To keep the Sabbath day holy
To honor your father and your mother

questions.text: What did Jesus say the scribes like to do?
questions.explanation: He said they like to walk in long robes, to get greetings in the marketplaces, and to have the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts.

answers.text: Fast in secret and give alms openly
Travel to far countries to teach
Walk in long robes and take the best seats
Keep silent in the temple courts

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the poor widow who cast in two small brass coins?
questions.explanation: He said she gave more than all those giving into the treasury, because the others gave out of their abundance but she gave all that she had to live on.

answers.text: She gave more than all the others
She should have kept her coins
She gave as much as the rich men
She gave what she could spare
